$description: Which committed baselines become App Store screenshots, and in what order. The iPhone set needs no capture of its own: the regression walk is pinned to iPhone 17 Pro Max, whose 1320x2868 output is exactly Apple's required 6.9 inch size, so these are the same images CI already pixel-compares. Order is the order Apple displays them, and slot 1 carries the most weight because most people never swipe past slot 2.
$notInStoreSet: walk.dark-trash, walk.dark-move-files, walk.dark-downloads-tutorial, walk.dark-routes, walk.dark-sessions, walk.dark-login, walk.dark-history-error. These are captured for regression coverage but are not marketing material — an error state or a settings list does not sell the app.
$missing: iPad. The app is TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY 1,2 so App Store Connect wants a 13 inch set (2064x2752) too. That needs a real capture lane rather than a selection, because there is no iPad walk yet.
